indication_area: Cystic fibrosis (patients 6+ with at least one F508del or another responsive CFTR mutation)
moa: CFTR corrector (vanzacaftor, tezacaftor) and potentiator (deutivacaftor) combination

approval_evidence.quote: application_number NDA218730, brand_name ALYFTREK, submission_type ORIG, submission_status AP, submission_status_date 20241220 (openFDA Drugs@FDA record)

launch_evidence.quote: Total revenue increased 3% to $2.77 billion compared to the first quarter of 2024, primarily driven by the continued performance of TRIKAFTA /KAFTRIO and an early contribution from the U.S. launch of ALYFTREK. (Vertex Q1 2025 release, Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 filed 2025-05-05)

series_start_reason: ALYFTREK was approved by the FDA on 2024-12-20; Vertex's FY2025 10-K product revenue table prints ALYFTREK 2024 as '—', and the first release to print an ALYFTREK row is Q1 2025, which is the launch quarter.
search_log: Listed every Vertex (CIK 875320) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions; scanned every 8-K with item 2.02 and every 10-Q/10-K filed 2024-10-01 to 2026-11-04 for 'ALYFTREK|JOURNAVX' in table rows and text (bin/scan.py).
ALYFTREK row printed in every quarterly release and 10-Q from Q1 2025 (53.9) on; 10-K FY2024 and the Q4 2024 release print no ALYFTREK revenue; FY2025 10-K prints ALYFTREK 837.8 with '—' for 2024.
Each quarter taken from its own quarterly release three-months column; Q4 2025 is the printed three-months figure (380.1) of the Q4 2025 release.

Check: 2025 quarters 53.9 + 156.8 + 247.0 + 380.1 = 837.8, equal to the twelve months figure printed in the Q4 2025 release and the FY2025 10-K. Prior-year columns of the Q1/Q2 2026 releases (53.9, 156.8) match the 2025 rows.
Series ends 2026Q2 per the brief (Q3 2026 release filed 2026-11-02 exists but is outside the target window).
